business_truths: 1099FIRE does not currently offer direct state filing.
When state participation is relevant, describe only Combined Federal/State Filing support and avoid implying direct filing with an individual state.
A final article should be human, practical, visually suggestive, and include a useful call to action.
style_rules: Prefer plain-English mental pictures, useful analogies, charts, or visual suggestions when they improve understanding.
Always retain or improve the 1099FIRE call to action.
